info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Fitness Memberships Status-v2-spec
info.description: The Fitness Memberships Status API provides a comprehensive view of the current status of fitness memberships within the platform. It allows users to retrieve detailed information on membership types, their active status, and user-specific details. This API is particularly useful for fitness center administrators and staff managing membership records, as well as for users wanting to check the status of their memberships. Through this endpoint, stakeholders can efficiently monitor and manage membership dynamics, ensuring optimal service delivery.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of memberships.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current status of all memberships associated with the account. It's useful for tracking membership validity and any associated benefits.

200.description: The current status of memberships retrieved successfully.
